messages:
Keisha (Billing): FYI - Skylark Health (CUST-14122) reported they were charged full for May after converting from trial. Invoice INV-2026-0812 shows a $1,000 charge plus a "trial-conversion" promo of -$1,000, but the net came through as $0 on invoice and customer was still charged via autopay for $1,000. Need to reconcile and issue refund if autopay already processed. Ticket: https://support.redwood/t/13088
finance-bot: Billing workflow note: autopay processed 2026-08-03 02:14 UTC. Payment REF# PYM-77821. Possible race between refund and invoice finalization.
Omar (Revenue Ops): Ugh. Looks like promo created a credit line but payment gateway still captured full amount. Do we have payment receipt ID? Keisha, can you pull gateway logs?
Keisha (Billing): Gateway shows capture PYM-77821 succeeded. We can either apply the existing promo as account credit (leaving payment intact) or refund $1,000 to card. Customer asks for refund to card. Need finance approval for >$500 refund.
Rohit (CS): Customer emailed: "Please refund the $1,000 to the card, we can't invoice-credit this month." They provided transaction evidence. High-touch account, renewal in 6 weeks.
Priya (CFO): Approve refund to card for $1,000 given customer request and race condition. Use GL 6350 for refund posting. Please document root cause and add to monthly reconciliation notes. Keisha, proceed and attach audit refs.
Keisha (Billing): Initiating REF-2026-512 to card on file. Also posting CM-2026-1510 for the accounting trail: 
```
Date: 2026-08-04
Account: 6350 - Customer Refunds
Customer: CUST-14122 (Skylark Health)
Amount: -1,000.00
Memo: Refund due to autopay capture after trial-conversion promo applied (INV-2026-0812)
Reference: REF-2026-512 / CM-2026-1510
```
Audit link: https://audit.redwood/ref/REF-2026-512 and https://audit.redwood/cm/CM-2026-1510. Refund ETA 3 business days.
finance-bot: Created ENG ticket ENG-5561 to add a pre-autopay check that ensures promo credits are fully applied before capture. Assigned to billing infra.
Omar (Revenue Ops): Also adding a promo-delivery test in CI for trial->paid flows. ENG-5562 linked from ENG-5561.
Rohit (CS): Notified customer with refund confirmation and timeline. They replied :pray:.
Keisha (Billing): Posted refund and CM. Marking BT-2026-901 closed. Please ensure GL and journal entries are sent to accounting for month-end.
Priya (CFO): Good. Please include in the August revenue memo and track any similar incidents. Thread resolved from finance side. :white_check_mark:
